image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a black audio cassette tape resting on a wooden surface. The image focuses on the top half of the cassette, showing the transparent plastic casing, two circular spool hubs, and a yellow label with illegible text. The bottom edge shows the rectangular opening for the tape mechanism. The background is blurred (bokeh), indicating a shallow depth of field.
